about: Models that are not guns. Each is exported from the player's own Cyberpunk install like the guns. A view model is fitted into a Black Ops weapon's own view model (fit_to = that weapon) so its animations carry it; a rigid model is only scaled from metres to Black Ops inches.

columns.id: unique id; the Black Ops xmodel is cpk_<id>
columns.cp_meshes: Cyberpunk depot paths merged into the model
columns.fit_to: Black Ops weapon whose view model is the fitting target (view), or none (rigid)
columns.scale: size multiplier (rigid: on top of metres-to-inches)
